errors.evidence: The MEMIT method is represented by a purple line with pentagon markers, not square markers.
The Base method starts at approximately 38%, not 39%, as shown in the figure.
The FT method increases to approximately 47%, not 48%, as shown in the figure.
The MEND method begins at approximately 45%, not 44%, as shown in the figure.
The MEMIT method begins at approximately 43%, but the description omits the slight variation visible in the figure (closer to 43.5%).
The description omits the sixth method, 'IKE,' represented by a red line with triangular markers.
The description does not mention the tick intervals on the x-axis (10^0, 10^1, 10^2, 10^3).
The description does not mention the tick intervals on the y-axis (40 to 65, at intervals of 5).
The description does not mention the legend placement in the top left corner of the plot.
